diagnostic_evidence.quote: Also, by the choice of the transition parameter $\tau _x$ in (\ref{transition parameters}) and the pointwise bound (\ref{derivs-split-extB}) on the layer component \[ \vert w_E(x_i,y_j) \vert \leq CN^{-2},\quad \hbox{if} \quad  x_i \leq 1-\tau _x. \]
Hence,  for the mesh points outside the right boundary layer region,  \[ \vert (W_E-w_E)(x_i,y_j) \vert \leq C N^{-2},\quad \hbox{for} \quad  x_i \leq 1-\tau_x. \]

issues.failure_explanation: The proof claims that when the horizontal Shishkin mesh is uniform (tau_x = 0.5), e^{-alpha*tau_x/eps} <= N^{-2}. This is the reverse of what the mesh definition gives: uniformity means min{0.5, 2*eps/alpha*ln N} = 0.5, i.e. eps/alpha >= 1/(4 ln N), hence alpha*tau_x/eps = alpha/(2 eps) <= 2 ln N, so e^{-alpha*tau_x/eps} >= N^{-2}. Counterexample: eps = 1, alpha = 1, N = 16 gives e^{-0.5} = 0.607 > 16^{-2}. The direction is reversed; the smallness of e^{-alpha*tau_x/eps} holds only when tau_x = 2*eps/alpha*ln N (the graded case). The claimed nodal bound |W_E - w_E| <= C N^{-2} for x_i <= 1 - tau_x therefore follows from a false premise in the uniform-mesh case (there |w_E| and |W_E| need not be O(N^{-2}) away from the layer).

failure_location.quote: Observe that in the case where the horizontal mesh is a uniform mesh (i.e., $\tau _x =0.5$), then $ e^{-\frac{\alpha \tau _x}{\ve}}\leq  N^{-2}$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Cover the nodes outside the right-layer region in the uniform-mesh case by the same barrier argument already carried out for the side region: the truncation-error bound displayed in the proof is explicitly stated to hold in both the case tau_x < 0.5 and tau_x = 0.5, so extending the barrier C[(N^{-1} ln N)^2 + (M^{-1} ln M)^2] e^{-alpha(1-x_i)/2*eps} (with its discrete-minimum-principle bound) to all x_i yields |(W_E - w_E)| <= C(N^{-1} ln N)^2 + ... there; no new machinery is needed.
issues.overall_effect: As written, the proof of the nodal bound (reg-layer-bound) for W_E - w_E is incomplete in the case tau_x = 0.5 (uniform horizontal mesh, i.e., eps >= alpha/(4 ln N), which includes the classical regime eps = 1); consequently the written justification of the global bound in Theorem main-result is also incomplete for that regime, since it collects the component bounds of Lemmas 3-6.
issues.title: Reversed Shishkin exponential estimate invalidates the uniform-mesh case of the regular-layer proof
issues.why_classification: A short, local bypass preserves every substantive claim: the correct direction of the estimate is read off from the definition of tau_x, and the barrier argument already present in the proof (stated to hold in both the tau_x < 0.5 and tau_x = 0.5 cases) bounds the error outside the layer by the same (N^{-1} ln N)^2 rate; the lemma's stated bounds and Theorem main-result survive unchanged, with no new lemma or construction needed.
